recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure continuity of Strategic Air Operations Centre operations by maintaining the reporting lines to the Air Transport Section as they are now, and using the expertise of the present staff. The Board also recommends that the Administration submit a proposal in this regard detailing the costs of moving the Strategic Air Operations Centre away from the current location and identifying the impact on field missions’ air operations in the light of earlier recommendations of the Board as endorsed by General Assembly.
